title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to e billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in billing months of July, August and September 1985. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
